_comment: Deterministic launch registry for common published MCP servers. Every launcher is pinned to an exact version (npx pkg@x.y.z, uvx pkg==x.y.z) so the plugin never runs whatever happens to be latest; re-check the pins when you touch this file (tests/test_known_servers.py enforces that they stay exact). github, brave-search, puppeteer and slack are deprecated on npm (no longer supported) and sqlite is archived; they are kept because people still ask for them. Capped at ~10 entries by design (see roadmap Review Notes) — this is not meant to be an exhaustive package index. Anything not listed here falls back to model knowledge, flagged as unverified.

filesystem._note: Needs at least one allowed directory: launched with none it advertises 0 tools (14 with one), which would grade as an empty server. Substitute <path> with a directory to expose, e.g. the project folder.

fetch._note: Not an npm package — @modelcontextprotocol/server-fetch 404s. Distributed as a Python package, launched via uvx.

git._note: Not an npm package — @modelcontextprotocol/server-git 404s. Distributed as a Python package, launched via uvx. --repository is required; substitute <path> with the target repo.

sqlite._note: Not an npm package — @modelcontextprotocol/server-sqlite 404s (archived from the npm scope). Distributed as a Python package, launched via uvx. --db-path is required; substitute <path> with the target database file.
